triage_cell_cluster.name: sim-cell
triage_cell_cluster.vtable_association: none recorded; Cell virtuals, if any, are hidden in unknown-vtable-impl

decompiled_campaign_capture.interpretation: The 26-function sim-cell cluster is the SDK Simulator::Cell slice; the campaign list also contains App::cCellModeStrategy functions, accessors, and lifecycle methods. 00e806b0 and 00e5b2e0 are high-value unnamed dependencies inspected directly with Ghidra but are not in the 26 SDK-named cluster.

original_game_boundary.not_assumed: The presence of a Cell SDK namespace does not establish a complete runtime object graph, a Cell vtable, AI execution, world population, event transport, or the full app bootstrap.

current_src_sim_boundary.role: Pure deterministic contract simulation plus typed static reconstructions of CellGame, free-list pool, query, advect, and combat rules.
current_src_sim_boundary.boundary: The current CellSim state is role/string/entity based and is not a byte-compatible cCellGame runtime. Its eat, flee, camera, speed, radius, and damping semantics are OpenSpore contract choices unless explicitly marked otherwise.

current_src_replace_boundary.role: One narrow replacement target: MovePlayerToMousePosition, plus a decompilation-derived reference and POD memory views.
current_src_replace_boundary.boundary: The installed replacement seam is established; the real 32-bit player-index lookup, runtime plane point, UI/camera gates, and live original differential are not established.

current_src_apps_boundary.role: Host-side scene loading, input, mode lifecycle shell, animation/effect/UI projections, and renderer presentation.
current_src_apps_boundary.boundary: The app composes the sim and renderer but does not reproduce the original IAppSystem bootstrap, message dispatch, stage transitions, or complete RenderWare/UI systems.

actual_boundaries.boundary_conclusion: The strongest defensible boundary is a four-way split: original state/runtime orchestration, deterministic movement/rule contracts, presentation/lifecycle projections, and one narrow replacement seam. The current source does not yet form an original Cell gameplay runtime.

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellGame::Initialize
function_contracts.contract: Initialize the global cell-game object: reset early flags/fields, initialize the 4096-cell main pool, set the 1.0f time scale and adjacent copy, initialize serializable/collectable state, set field_4124=20, and write the background bounding box constants.

function_contracts.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::Initialize
function_contracts.contract: Allocate or assign sCellGame, sCellGFX, and sCellUI, initialize mode flags, and perform application pre-shutdown/setup calls. The original body is broader than the current clean-room shell.
postconditions: three Cell singleton pointers established or null

function_contracts.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::Dispose
function_contracts.contract: Tear down active cell state, restore global background colors, dispose/release sCellGFX and sCellUI resources, release sCellGame, and perform pause/unpause side effects.

function_contracts.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::OnEnter
function_contracts.contract: Reset mode/UI flags, start cell display, enable the cell world/render path, and invoke world/UI/application activation side effects.

function_contracts.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::OnExit
function_contracts.contract: Restore background-map clear-color globals, drain/clean cell state, disable the cell mode, and release world/effect state.

function_contracts.name: FUN_00e806b0
function_contracts.contract: If the cell-game mode/state word at +0x51e0 is zero and the +0x515c gate is clear, update mode counters/services with scaled delta, call MovePlayerToMousePosition, then invoke post-movement cell update, AI/behavior, graphics, and effect functions. Other state words enter texture/id generation branches.
preconditions: function is invoked through the mode vtable
function_contracts.confidence: SUPPORTED for branch/call shape; INFERRED for unnamed arguments

function_contracts.name: App::cCellModeStrategy::Update
function_contracts.contract: void update(cCellModeStrategy*, float fDelta1, float fDelta2) { FUN_00e806b0(this, fDelta1); }
postconditions: real per-frame cell update body is invoked

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::MovePlayerToMousePosition
function_contracts.contract: If sCellGame+0x5158 is nonzero, return. Resolve the player via FUN_00b721d0(sCellGame+0x411c); if null, return. Run per-frame/camera/UI gates. Fetch origin and normalized view ray. If dot(dir,N) is nonzero and t>=0, write target=origin+dir*t to player+0x08/0x0c/0x10, set the moving flag, compute travel orientation from current position and write player+0x14..0x20.
preconditions: camera mode and UI selection allow steering

function_contracts.name: FUN_00e5b2e0
function_contracts.contract: Per-frame cell UI/world update: resolve the avatar, adjust the current swim-plane point from UI bitfields, mark the moving flag when adjustments occur, normalize direction, compute a target displacement, write the avatar target position, clear idle, and maintain UI plane state.
postconditions: avatar target position and moving state may change
function_contracts.confidence: SUPPORTED for writes/flow; INFERRED for UI bit meanings

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::CreateCellObject
function_contracts.contract: Allocate a pool object, derive cell size from scale/resource/explicit size, initialize target orientation and position, elevation, opacity, transform scale, model key, scale level, query and effect/GFX state, and return the pool index.
preconditions: main pool has a free entry
postconditions: new allocated cCellObjectData or invalid index on exhaustion
function_contracts.confidence: SUPPORTED for core sequence; INFERRED for omitted resource/AI details

function_contracts.name: FUN_00e780a0 / cell-object-pool-lifecycle
function_contracts.contract: Given a pool index, clear the avatar reference if it matches, release old GFX/associated object, rebuild when stage scale changes, and recreate the pooled cell object.
preconditions: cell object and associated graphics state available
postconditions: avatar reference and associated graphics state reconciled

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::PlayAnimation
function_contracts.contract: If the model instance and GFX object are live, calculate blend times from current/target animation, scale by the cell animation-time factor, dispatch the target animation, and write animation state/blend fields.
postconditions: animation state and blend duration updated, or no-op

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::cCellGFX::LoadEffectMap
function_contracts.contract: For each effect-map record, select a persistent slot by record type (0/2 -> slot 0, 1/3 -> slot 1, 4 -> slot 2), create/replace/start the effect, and update effect parameters using cell and background geometry.
postconditions: three effect slots reflect active records

function_contracts.contract: Select foreground/background effect slot, read the nine-word effect-map parameter record, override the first three words with the swim-plane point and word 3 with 1.0f, instantiate the effect, place it on the cell transform, and return the effect pointer.

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::GetScaleDifferenceWithPlayer
function_contracts.contract: Resolve the other cell's scale bucket and the player bucket, subtract player from other, center the result at Equal=2, and clamp to MuchSmaller..MuchLarger.

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::GetDamageAmount
function_contracts.contract: Return player-attacker damage by victim difference, non-player two-cell damage from the 5x5 matrix, or non-player-vs-player damage by attacker difference. Values are 0..6; equal player case is 2 or 3 depending on player flag at sCellGame+0x5190+0x7c.
preconditions: attacker/victim cell pointers and player scale/flag available

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::ShouldNotAttack
function_contracts.contract: Return true for same resource, bypass-field cases return false, passive/smaller-than-player resource flags suppress attacks against the player, and equal non-zero territory suppresses attacks; otherwise return false.

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::GetCurrentAdvectInfo
function_contracts.contract: Resolve current world resource and player scale bucket, scan advect entries, return exact playerSize match immediately, otherwise retain the -1 default entry, and write scale/strength/variance/period plus return advect ID.
preconditions: current world resource and advect entries available
postconditions: advect info outputs written; default or no-match values returned

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::GetNextAdvectID
function_contracts.contract: Resolve current world and scale bucket, scan entries for the next bucket, return its advect ID, otherwise return the -1 default advect ID, otherwise 0.
preconditions: current world and advect entries available

function_contracts.name: Simulator::Cell::GetModelKeyForCellResource

conclusion.confidence: SUPPORTED for static boundaries and named function inventory; INFERRED/APPROXIMATION for unwired runtime semantics
conclusion.summary: The actual Cell domain is broader than src/sim/Sim.cpp and narrower than the original Simulator::Cell runtime. The strongest static core is cCellGame initialization, the 4096-cell free-list pool, CreateCellObject, spatial query, combat/advect pure functions, movement target replacement, and the mode/Gfx/UI lifecycle projections. The largest unresolved boundary is the unnamed per-frame orchestrator FUN_00e806b0 and the service/continuation graph around it. The current source provides deterministic contracts and host projections but does not claim original runtime fidelity.
